title: Understanding Model Complexity
text: Model complexity in linear regression can be influenced by regularization techniques. Regularization involves adding a penalty term to the loss function to prevent overfitting.

title: Role of Lambda (λ) in Regularization
text: In regularization, lambda (λ) is a parameter that controls the strength of the penalty. A higher λ increases the penalty on large coefficients, which can reduce model complexity.

title: Effect of Increasing Lambda
text: Increasing λ in regularization methods like Ridge or Lasso regression tends to shrink the coefficients, leading to a simpler model with potentially less overfitting.

title: Choosing the Correct Option
text: Which option correctly describes the effect of increasing λ on model complexity?
choices: Changing lambda has no effect on model complexity
Both increasing and decreasing lambda reduce complexity equally
The effect of lambda depends on the choice of g(theta)
